_about: P833 Call Receiver config. By Ethan Brady & Ryan Raikes. Installed at /etc/p833-receiver/config.json. Restart the service after editing: sudo systemctl restart p833-receiver

audio._note: Page = lead_silence_ms of silence, then department tone (per code, see codes.tone), English, Spanish, played 'repeat' times. tones: once, twice or off. Voice clips are made by tools/make_audio.py; tone files are in audio/tones.

phone._note: HT813 phone step settings. Easier to tune on the admin page, which saves its own values on top of these.

floor._note: Digits the HT813 dials on the ATA2 line to page the factory floor. Empty = not set yet. Easier to set on the admin page.

office._note: Not used by any code yet.
